scenarios.title: Two monitoring regions, a sheltered lower route
scenarios.description: Two monitoring regions are separated by a cluster of circular obstacles. A strong central wind opposes travel from B to A. The lower bypass is sheltered; the upper bypass is longer.

scenarios.title: Wind in both direct passages
scenarios.description: The same monitoring task and obstacles, with strong opposing wind in both the central passage and the lower bypass. The upper route remains sheltered.

scenarios.title: Monitoring in an extended obstacle field
scenarios.description: Two monitoring regions lie on the west side of a larger obstacle field. Wind also occupies the eastern passages, away from many of the candidate routes that serve the monitoring task.

scenarios.title: Monitoring away from the wind
scenarios.description: A wide monitoring region occupies the upper part of the environment, around a circular obstacle. Strong wind is concentrated in the lower-right region. The robot starts with unknown wind everywhere.
